findings.subject: Human biological units
findings.assessment: People and specimens remain separate. Full-paper fields are null; one liver specimen is not an independent population or a universal mechanism.

findings.subject: Organ-specific causal inference
findings.assessment: Normal hepatic respiratory-chain activity is not promoted to normal canalicular transport, reserve, all mitochondrial function or exact-drug tolerance. No universal new liver gate is added.

findings.subject: Prior model and clinical context
findings.assessment: Zebrafish, diet-sensitive mouse, DNM2 antisense and lifelong healthy catalytic-inactivation findings remain attached to their original systems and are not counted as new BLU evidence.

findings.subject: EXCEL plan/status distinction
findings.assessment: Dated planned enrollment, duration and assessments are not presented as actual current enrollment, completion, outcomes or a ready assay/data route.

findings.subject: Exact capsid and dose claim
findings.assessment: MyoAAV3.8 is verified visually. The 100-fold claim remains a sponsor starting-dose comparison with no absolute dose, equal efficacy, risk reduction or therapeutic-window calculation.

findings.subject: Same-event deduplication
findings.assessment: Slide and transcript are correctly one April 27, 2026 sponsor event, not independent biological corroboration.

findings.subject: VALOR population and outcome limits
findings.assessment: Selected young, severely ventilated eligibility is not an eventual label, actual dosed denominator or residual-market estimate. No ASP2957 clinical result is asserted.

findings.subject: Long-term follow-up source ceiling
findings.assessment: The detailed LTFU record remains unread; indexed status and identifiers are not promoted into duration, observed durability, actual enrollment or an independent treated cohort.

findings.subject: Exact product identity
findings.assessment: AT132 clinical benefits and cholestatic deaths are not transferred to ASP2957 or BLU. Dish force is not converted into ventilator independence.

findings.subject: TAM4MTM counts and reporting
findings.assessment: Fresh indexed publication plans remain separate from carried-forward six registry participants, seven investigator-reported completions and two hepatic serious adverse events. No new outcome or invented national split.

findings.subject: Staged economic scope
findings.assessment: Qualification and conditional function increments remain separate, illustrative and unvalidated. Scope escalation triggers a new comparison; no automatic investment or complete organ program is imposed.

findings.subject: Contribution, rights and ranking
findings.assessment: No fixed gene-therapy-excluded niche, broad population monetization, safer/cheaper oral assumption or retained financial value is asserted. BLU source priority does not change APR1/RM2/BLU3 development order.

findings.subject: Integrity and restrictions
findings.assessment: Strict JSON parsed; all 15 source records and 22 evidence rows resolve within their ledgers, six hepatic claim supports resolve, local links exist and all six activity fields are false.

review_method: Read both complete authored files; independently inspect accessible primary abstract, sponsor notice, program slide/transcript and VALOR/ASPIRO passages; reproduce only the stated official indexed LTFU and TAM reporting fields; compare relevant prior repository records; check scope/causality/cost logic; perform document integrity checks and bind final bytes.
